2023 Recap of AI developments

  • Posted in: 2024-01-03
  • Posted by: Digwatch

In the swiftly evolving landscape of the artificial intelegence technology, returning to the incipit of this revolutionary invention’s precise moment of origin is complex. However, in the third decade of the 20th century, the earliest materialisation of such ideas and concepts occurred in literature. Namely, the term ‘robot’, found for the first time in Karel Čapek’s 1921 play R.U.R. (Rossum’s Universal Robots), has been representing autonomous humanoid creatures made of artificial matter, and featuring, etymologically speaking, independent and unpaid workforce (from Czech word ‘robota‘ – forced/unpaid labour).

Read More

Navigating the Healthcare Landscape: A Comprehensive Guide to HIPAA Compliance in Hospitals.

  • Posted in: 2024-01-08
  • Posted by: Danphe Health

In the ever-evolving realm of healthcare, safeguarding patient information is of paramount importance. The Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) plays a central role in ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of patient data. This blog provides an overview of HIPAA compliance, explores its advantages, and delves into the policies implemented in hospitals to uphold these standards.

How do electronic health records (EHR or EMR) make healthcare better?

  • Posted in: 2023-02-17
  • Posted by: Eduhealth System

There is a growing interest in EHRs around the world. Technology and innovations are changing the health industry, governments and organizations are focusing on providing better health services to the public.

Importance of Electronic Health Records in Nursing

  • Posted in: 2023-05-04
  • Posted by: Regis College

In 2009, only 12% of hospitals used EHRs, according to the Office of the National Coordinator for Health Information Technology. By 2021 — thanks in part to $27 billion in financial incentives from Congress — EHRs were almost universal, with 96% of hospitals adopting them.
